D/ P SEPT GETA CAES PO[NT] ; R/ PRINC IVVENTVTIS

Silver coin. Denarius of Geta (209-212), as kindly identified by the finder. Mint of Rome issue of 200, Sear vol. 2 no. 7196; RIC vol. 4 part 1 no. 18. Obverse description: Youthful head with big ear, coiffed and draped, right. Obverse inscription: P SEPT GETA CAES PO[NT]. Reverse description: [Geta as] ?Mars standing left holding vertical sceptre, trophy with globe at its foot to right. Reverse…
